name: Sant Jaume de Frontanyà (Spain)
description: Dark green field charged at the centre with the white horse of the arms passant towards the hoist.
history: The flag was approved on 7 January 2010 and published in the Diari Oficial de la Generalitat de Catalunya no. 5555 of 28 January 2010; it is an oblong flag of 2:3, dark green, with the white horse of the arms passant towards the hoist, 3/4 of the height and 15/24 of the length, at the centre.

features.role: horse passant towards the hoist, 3/4 of the height
